details: Retried 2026-11-09: the accepted manuscript (pure.qub.ac.uk/files/124685150, also core.ac.uk/download/74408075.pdf) still answers HTTP 403 to WebFetch and to a plain download on the PC, Europe PMC has no full text (not in PMC, not open access) and the abstract has no numbers, so no published check can be made.
